verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a requests-per-second or requests-per-minute limit enforced on an API key, nor when throttling starts. The only related item is a Usage API that reports real-time credit and concurrency usage. Concurrency usage is a different control from a documented request-rate limit, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I know the documented rate limit (requests per second or minute) enforced on my API key before throttling kicks in
